messages.バリアと防御レベル増加で非常に打たれ強い充電の人格。S2で充電回数を稼ぎ、守備「: A highly durable Charge Identity protected by Shield and Defense Level Up. Build Charge Count with S2, endure attacks and replenish Charge through CCA Overcharge, then unleash the main S3 Rip Space - CCA Overdrive at maximum enhancement.
messages.S3が主力火力: 使用時に、充電回数が10以上なら10消耗してコイン威力+4。充: **S3 is his main damage**: On use, with 10 or more Charge Count, spends 10 for +4 Coin Power. Clash Power rises by his Charge Potency, up to 5. Coins Ⅰ and Ⅱ add +1 Charge Count on Heads Hit, and Coin Ⅲ adds +2. Coin Ⅳ spends up to 10 Charge Count at the start of its Coin toss and gains power equal to the amount spent. It then inflicts 2 Rupture and deals Slash damage equal to Charge Potency×5%, up to 25%/50%. If Coins Ⅰ–Ⅲ all land Heads, 16 Charge Count beforehand reaches the maximum enhancement. At Combat Start, with 3 or more Charge Potency or HP below 50%, all Coins become Unbreakable.
messages.S2「ブースト・エルボーカッター」で充電稼ぎ: 戦闘開始時に、充電力場を(2+充: **Building Charge with S2 Boost: Elbow Blade**: At Combat Start, grants (2 + Charge Potency) Charge Barrier, up to 6, once per turn. Charge Count increases on Coin Ⅰ hit. Spending 6 Charge Count on use grants +1 Coin Power.
messages.守備「CCA過充電」: マッチ可能ガード。戦闘開始時に充電回数が15未満なら、次: **Defense skill — CCA Overcharge**: A Clashable Guard. If Charge Count is below 15 at Combat Start, three things happen: he gains Overcharge next turn, removes the nearest Stagger Threshold at Turn End (once per battle), and adds 1 S3 to next turn's skill list. With 15 or more Charge Count, none of these happen and it is just a Clashable Guard. During Overcharge, he is Immobilized but takes less damage. At Turn End when Overcharge disappears, he gains 10 Charge Count and 2 Attack Power Up for the next turn.
messages.硬さ: パッシブ「防御志向充電」で、累計10消耗ごとに充電1を得て、ターン開始時: **Durability**: Through the passive Defence-Oriented Charge, he gains 1 Charge per cumulative 10 spent and gains Defense Level Up equal to his Charge Potency at Turn Start, up to 6. Through Congestion Cleaning Armour (5 Envy Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ), he gains Shield equal to his Charge Potency right before taking damage, up to 5, 3 times per turn.
messages.S1は弱め: S1「混雑乗客の整理」は、Ⅰコインの的中時にしか充電回数が増えない: **S1 is weak**: S1 Congestion Cleanup only increases Charge Count on Coin Ⅰ hit.
messages.S2・S3を中心に戦い、弱いS1を守備に置き換えて過充電を挟み、充電を補ってから: Fight mainly with S2 and S3, replace the weak S1 with his Defense skill to slot in Overcharge, replenish Charge, then fire S3. Overcharge's effects are decided at Combat Start, so they activate even if he is not attacked. However, he cannot take Clashes himself while Immobilized, so treat extra Charge from hits as a bonus. Both Overcharge and the extra S3 are written as "next turn" in the effect text, making it a three-turn flow: Defense skill → Immobilized → S3. He is better suited to Focused Encounters, where he can choose his target.
